_comment: Drift baseline for the plugin-native generation model. The published kotlin-sdkgen 0.3.0 plugin generates a content-addressed snapshot under build/ (not checked in). Every field below is validated by scripts/check-drift.sh after regenerating from the pinned spec; a mismatch is drift. Spec digest and generator coordinate provenance live in spec/pin.json and spec/sdkgen.yaml (the spec digest is additionally enforced by the generator at generation time).
